_comment: Zone rules for the $0 setup (docs/HOSTING_PLAN.md), applied by scripts/cf_rules.py. $HOSTS is replaced by the hostnames served from R2 and $WWW by the www hostnames that redirect to their apex. Only rules whose ref starts with limbowatch- are managed; others in the zone are left alone.

http_request_dynamic_redirect.description: www to the apex, same path and query
a page without its slash: pages are directories and every file has an extension
http_request_dynamic_redirect.expression: http.host in $HOSTS and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") and not http.request.uri.path contains "."

http_response_headers_transform.description: the security headers nginx sent, on every response

Content-Security-Policy.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://www.googletagmanager.com https://*.google-analytics.com; connect-src 'self' https://api.deps.dev https://www.googletagmanager.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.google.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

http_response_headers_transform.description: the feed, OSV files and metrics are for tools: any origin may fetch them
http_response_headers_transform.expression: http.host in $HOSTS and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/feed/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/osv/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/metrics.json")

http_request_cache_settings.description: cache everything, for each file's own max-age
